packageRules.description: Reimplements group:allNonMajor plus digest updates, since the preset's minor/patch match misses digests
A minor bump on a 0.x cargo dep is a breaking change under semver, so it gets its own PR and a human reviewer. Must stay ordered after the grouping rule above, since later packageRules win.

The .mise.toml pin, Cargo.toml's rust-version and rust-toolchain.toml's channel stay equal, so they move in one grouped PR with a human reviewer. The regex manager below covers rust-version, which no native manager reads.
Research probes record what was measured with the versions they name; bumping them would change the evidence.

customManagers.description: Cargo.toml's rust-version is the toolchain pin's third copy; Renovate's cargo manager does not read it.
